Matrix f8493b130354123a57115f85bc1d6cdeab776a64697234962063604594b9c1cd/source_manifest_v3, all91 production sources/ROM, parent9d877217, original11parent generics and complete dot/format subtree remain unchanged. PROFILE0/OOC/flatten none/single synthesis worker and original300MHz XDC remain; requested3.333333333ns resolves3.333ns. No RTL/numeric/capacity/interface or PS candidate change. Original D37 complete30 normal-path functional evidence and local four-state storage-representation bridge retain their exact original scope; no new full30 run.

AT019 is the one authorized causal core synthesis retry from scratch after AT015 ended without DCP. v7 adds only official locally verified synth_design -no_timing_driven to core_synth; all other stage options/stubs remain unchanged. Frozen manual and native synth_design-help evidence are input/no_timing_driven_support.json. Mapping/resource results and final routed300MHz setup/hold remain distinct.

User then explicitly removed physical synthesis/implementation/reports single/cumulative wall limits. The current original Vivado was retained; external no-deadline supervision activated23:44:46.737830UTC with maximum_seconds/deadline=null. Future runner applies explicitNone to the same three categories; prep/repair original caps remain. Physical256GiB/MemAvailable>192GiB/CPU0-3/nice19/idleIO/one-heavy-lock/300srealCPU+fileprogress protections remain. Original commands/frozen code/costs/raw receipts retain historical identity; effective receipts augment separately.

Only old ended AT002/003/015 rebuildable .rtd/.tim caches were deleted by the controller under user authorization, freeing4.14223GiB;358 other old files SHA unchanged. ActiveAT019/sharedinputs/ROM/DCPs/useful evidence are preserved. Root owns two-hour reports/timer; the actual serial continuation waits verified corePASS/DCP/cleanup/lock release, then executes the approved13stages without core retry.

Administrator read-only stack diagnostic entry is prepared/frozen at SHA6621497d6e4e815a2076ce565d9d820e7f5e8236c21b5149b17f0157c286e4b0. It is fixed to native Vivado3583093/start66052106 and does not attach/resume the retired guard or monitors. Engineering only ran plan/preflight and two isolated Python-process tests, not a production attachment. The original frozen guard loop and current external monitor have separate recorded byte identities.

# E022 当前结果与等待态边界

AT019原生综合日志报告0errors/0criticalwarnings/2749warnings，但synth_design尚未返回到intermediate_scope写入，未取得core DCP或最终guard收据。当前为post-synthesis wait unresolved。383.629s线程观察中，主线程及累计CPU最高线程均+0ticks/futex等待，仅周期sleep线程增加CPU；日志884747B及全部写I/O不变。总CPU增加不作为有效综合推进。

发现同组收养僵尸3633734，但冻结原guard运行循环本来不reap，reap仅在finally/cleanup，故不能把等待直接归因于SIGSTOP交接。旧guard缓存有限limit且直接比较elapsed>=limit；禁止直接CONT以免复活旧期限。当前无墙钟monitor/三监督及原进程/锁保持，无新EDA或重试。

用户已选择由管理员执行一次固定目标只读栈诊断。入口已冻结SHA6621497d6e4e815a2076ce565d9d820e7f5e8236c21b5149b17f0157c286e4b0，CPU0-3/nice19/idle、关闭autoload/debuginfod/目标写与函数调用；info threads、info sharedlibrary、各线程bt16，20s+最多7s自身gdb清理并核detach。最终版本2/2真实小Python进程测试PASS（正常0.266s、超时0.533s）；仅基础设施证据。工程没有生产attach/sudo。正在轻量观察DG原始输出，实际报告到达立即送主控/A014。

生产f849/91源/ROM、父/11generic、完整子树、300MHzXDC及PS暂停不变。已有continuation仅等待，最终资源/fit/布局布线/setup/hold及覆盖未验；原D37功能证据保持原范围。原生Cell Usage不代签最终资源。
